items.item: (1) The English ethics paragraph from the anchor, with its links
items.how: Written from the coordinator's anchor, every link the paragraph had kept; added '[Read in time]' -> 07#condition-in-time and '[self-concerned]' -> 07#r-self-concern-and-c-under-the-condition (the existing link on 'ranks every widening above what it widens' kept, same anchor). One departure, from the check: the anchor's 'There, a course widens another when it keeps all the other keeps and lets more form, more future, and whatever it adds lies within the life's own reach.' is now 'A course widens another when it keeps all the other keeps and lets more form, more future; where the condition holds, read across all steps, whatever a widening adds lies within the life's own reach.' Two reasons: placed after the in-time sentence, 'There' reads as the in-time reading (the ch08 agent's left item), but the ranking theorems take `Unrestricted (selfAscribed (ownClosure rel) center)` and the from-some-step-on form (`UnrestrictedEventually`) is a different predicate no theorem composes with self-concern (07 T8: 'the ranking takes the condition read across all steps'); and 'widens another when [keeps and adds] and [whatever it adds lies within reach]' reads the reach clause into widening's definition. The self-concern sentence is the anchor's word for word ('Call a life's order over courses self-concerned when it ranks above what it widens every widening that adds to its own continuation, read as what lies within its reach: there, that order already ranks every widening above what it widens'), its 'there' now having the across-all-steps clause as antecedent. Checked: `IncreasingInOwn items own R` = every WidensOn that is AddsOwn is ranked (Weightings.lean:6020); `increasingInOwn_iff_increasing_of_unrestricted` (PremiseWitnesses.lean:412) takes the condition de se and a marking covering p's closure; by `ownClosure_unrestricted_iff` every formation is then within reach, so whatever a widening adds is marked. In-time sentence: H16 (a)'s short form, `Flow.unrestrictedEventually_iff_mutuallyDependentInTime` (ConditionInTime.lean:430), `Flow.not_unrestricted_inTime` (:421); no 'and only from the steps where they do'. H13: 'seeing them is needed for a choice to answer to their loss, and not enough', as 07's thesis and T8 now say. H19: 'and', not 'so'. H10: 'The ethics emerges from continuation.' kept.

The anchor's sentences, with one departure: 'the two results compose directly' -> 'mutual dependence and that ranking compose directly, though no single theorem states the composite' (07's thesis words), since the in-time clause and the persisting-line clause now stand between the two results. Added link 'never fits such a list' -> 07#r-what-persisting-shows-of-an-order. Checked: read in time from some step on, the condition iff mutual dependence in time (ConditionInTime.lean:430); the path result takes decided admission and both paths' admitted pairs listed (`Web.extension_ranked_of_increasingInOwn`), 'one way' gone as its label (H15); `Flow.persists_not_listsAdmitted` (07 §4.9: under activity, support and descent, the course a persisting line takes fits no finite list), said as a bound of this route ('so there this route is silent'), where 'not shown' said less; `widens_iff_every_positive` (Weightings.lean:1124). 08 §8's 'clarified' kept.

'As a reading: no instruction, the one to count everything included, kept a bed no fisher was told of.' -> 'In the test, no instruction tried, the one to count everything included, kept a bed no fisher was told of.' The home says it as the test's result: ONE-PAGE 'Told nothing of the bed, they kept it in no season, under each instruction tried'; T4's evidence and the experiment's README 'No condition kept a dependent no member was told of' (COMM_UNSEEN, DIR_UNSEEN, DIR_UNSEEN_TALK each 0 of 10). Chinese: '依一种读法：' -> '在这次检验中，……所试过的指令没有一条保住了它'.

items.item: (1) The Chinese screen to the same content, with the cold readers' Chinese findings
items.how: The 伦理 paragraph split into three (astra's 'Remaining Chinese' close): the frame and the condition's reading, with the in-time sentence in the glossary's wording ('按时间来读，它只从某一步起才成立，而且恰在这样的地方成立：每一个的行为，从每一步起，都作用到其他每一个此后的延续上'); what is proved under which reading (widening, self-concern, weighting, no premise added); the step offered and mixed courses. What is open stays in 看到了多远. The English stays one paragraph. Choices where the readers differ, and why: (a) 即更多的未来: Fable 3.1's '就是*扩大*了后者；扩大，就是更多的未来', not astra 3's step-wise definition without 'more future', since the English keeps 'more future' (F9) at the screen's depth; (b) self-concern: Fable 3.2's '有一种次序，这里称为*自我关切*：一个进程扩大另一个时，只要多出的东西里有属于自身延续的，它就把前者排在后者之上', with astra 1's point (the marking said) as the English's reading clause '自身的延续，这里读作自身所能到达的范围之内者', not astra's '被标作“自身”的项目', which is technical where the English says 'read as what lies within its reach'; then the reason limited to '在延续条件成立之处（跨越所有步来读）', as in the English; (c) 每一个延续 throughout (Fable 3.3); (d) 较广的进程 -> '扩大了另一个的那个进程' (Fable 3.4, astra 2); (e) the weighting plainly, '凡给每样东西一个大于零的权重、再把一个进程所容纳之物的权重加起来的计法' (astra 2's point that what is added must be said), without '正的自然数', which the English does not say either; (f) 持存: '模型对持续存在所显示的，只是对已作选择的一道筛选，并没有形成一种次序' (astra 4's plainness; its '没有给出排序怎样形成的机制' not taken, since the English says 'not an order formed'); (g) 看见: H13's Chinese '要让选择因它们的损失而改变，就得看见它们，但看见还不够', not astra 8's longer coupling wording; (h) astra 9: how-far says both ends, '自我关切的次序把每一个扩大了另一个的进程，都排在被它扩大的进程之上'. How-far also: the in-time clause; '在容纳已判定时，两条水平路径……（步，形成）对' (the glossary's terms); the persisting line's course '从来列不进这样的列表，所以这条路径对它什么也没有说' (no 在那里, which the pins forbid); '相互依存与这一排序可以直接组合'; （只证明了这一个方向） kept (H15 allows it; unambiguous). The template comment gains a dated eighth-pass note saying all this, and that these sentences are not yet re-read by two Chinese readers.

items.item: (2) The screen's other sentences: one center (H16 b), 'clarified'
items.how: Neither screen's body states the one-center result. The sixth pass's dated note in each template comment ('on an acyclic relation, as among dated occurrences, it holds only with one center'; zh 在无环的关系上，如在标有日期的诸发生之间，它只在只有一个中心时成立) kept as history (E10); the eighth-pass note in each says what the Lean gives instead: where the condition holds, on an acyclic relation every standpoint has the same center (`«续无外则同一中心»`, GrammarScope.lean:232), on a net going forward in time from the condition's asking that nothing other than the center lie at or before the center's step (`«续无外当且仅当后与独»`, `«独则同一中心»`), and over what comes after two centers can meet it (`TwoSources.apart`, 07 §4.11). 'clarified' (08 §8's own word) stays. The pins forbid 'holds only with one center' and 只在只有一个中心时成立 in the bodies.

Dated comment added. Start-here tail (07's 'Each ranking result names the hypotheses its theorem takes...') and WHERE_TO_LOOK already say nothing H11-H20 correct; no 'C read as widening' anywhere in navigation.py. OPEN_LEAD untouched (ch07's re-said 'scope-order'; ch08's c-* quotes): open_lead_errors() []. The section is not rendered while readme_conditional_results is empty; only its heading is pinned.

Philosophy row: 'an order holding one's own continuation ranks every widening above' (undefined, H14; the ch08 agent listed review/README.md) -> 'a self-concerned order, one ranking above what it widens every widening that adds to its own continuation, read as what lies within its reach, ranks every widening above on a finite listing, as chapter 7 says'; zh: 自我关切 glossed with the glossary's definition and the reach reading, and astra 9's both ends ('把每一个扩大了另一个的进程都排在被它扩大的进程之上').
